name: Chilaquiles Verdes with Eggs
desc: Fried tortilla chips tossed in charred tomatillo salsa, served with fried eggs, beans and rice.

source.title: Chilaquiles Verdes with Eggs
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 small white onion, cut into thick slices
12 corn tortillas, cut into 6 triangles each
About 1 cup vegetable oil, for frying (1/8 inch deep)

steps: Salsa: heat a large dry skillet over medium-high heat. Add the tomatillos, jalapeños and onion and cook, turning, until charred in spots and the tomatillos are soft, 8 to 10 minutes. Season with the salt and pepper.
Blend the charred vegetables until smooth, adding water 1 tbsp at a time if it's too thick to blend. Taste and adjust the salt.

Chips: heat 1/8 inch of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the tortilla triangles in batches, turning once, until golden and crisp, 1 to 2 minutes per batch. Drain on a paper towel-lined plate and sprinkle with a little salt.
Fry the eggs in a spoonful of the hot oil over medium heat until the whites are set and the edges crisp, 2 to 3 minutes. Set aside.
Wipe out the pan, pour in the salsa and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Add the chips and fold until coated.
Plate the chilaquiles right away with the fried eggs, refried beans and rice, and finish with crema and cotija.
tips: Toss the chips right before serving so they stay a little crunchy.
The creator's rice is cooked in tomato broth with carrots and corn.
